name: AI Infrastructure Refresh — Locked Solid Backlog
rationale: Updated analysis accounting for 2B+ in locked-in data center buildouts over the next 24 months. Traditional TTM-anchored DCF fails to capture the massive contracted backlog. Using Forward Run-Rate Optionality to model the infrastructure transition.

bear.rationale: Bear: Data center buildout delayed by 12 months; only 1/3 of projected capacity realized by year 5. $1B optionality assumes liquidation value of hardware. 40% growth still reflects massive backlog execution.

base.rationale: Base: 24-month buildout 'locked solid'; 3.5GW capacity realized. $5B optionality for the AI GPU cluster contracts. 90% CAGR reflects the structural jump from $144M to the multi-billion infrastructure run-rate.

bull.rationale: Bull: APLD becomes the leading private AI hyperscaler. Multi-GW contracts fully realized + massive software layer monetization. $12B optionality for the 5+ GW 'locked in' infra.

aiThesis.rationale: APLD has graduated from a commodity miner into a strategic AI infrastructure utility. At 9, the market is finally realizing the value of the 3.5GW+ contracted buildout. Our weighted fair value of 8.35 represents 49% upside from current levels, justified by the lock-solid infrastructure backlog.
